title: General Terms of the Entrance Fee Agreement Tax Letter
content:
Tax statement office terms of the tax letter sent under an **Entrance Fee Agreement**.

1. Each agreement whose resident paid entrance fee or independent living monthly fees in a tax year receives one tax letter for that year, issued by the plan's tax letter deadline of the following year.

2. Amount stated.

> Retired clause, no longer in force: the clause that the medical expense amount stated is the plan's entrance fee medical expense percentage of the entrance fee received in the tax year plus the plan's monthly fee medical expense percentage of the independent living monthly fees paid in the tax year, rounded to the cent half up. It is superseded by the current basis for the medical expense amount of each letter.

   A plan whose percentages are 0.0 receives a letter stating 0.00.

3. A reissued letter for the same tax year replaces nothing on the account and is not a second letter; Larkspur does not give tax advice.

4. Number of letters.

> Retired clause, no longer in force: "One tax letter is issued per agreement per tax year." It is superseded by the current basis for how many letters each tax year receives and when they are issued.

## Points of reading

| Question | Answer from these terms |
|---|---|
| A resident paid independent living monthly fees but no entrance fee in a year | The agreement receives a tax letter for that year |
| A plan with both percentages at 0.0 | The letter states 0.00 |
| A copy of a letter already issued is sent again | It is a reissue, not a second letter, and changes nothing on the account |
| A caller asks how to claim the amount on a tax return | Larkspur does not give tax advice |

superseded_clauses: The medical expense amount stated is medical_expense_pct_entrance_fee percent of the entrance fee received in the tax year plus medical_expense_pct_monthly_fee percent of the independent living monthly fees paid in the tax year, rounded to the cent half up
One tax letter is issued per agreement per tax year.
